outcome: time to first passage of flatus
cohort: 200 pregnant women undergoing elective cesarean sections at a tertiary care center in Bhubaneswar, India, divided into two groups of 100 each: one receiving ERAS protocol and the other receiving conventional perioperative care.
finding: The ERAS protocol significantly reduced the duration of hospital stay and time to various postoperative milestones (first oral intake, bowel sounds, ambulation, catheter removal, flatus, and bowel movement) compared to conventional care.
